<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_LANParty" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lan-party">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_GameList" name="Game list received"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LANParty" name="LAN Party" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Planning" name="Planning started"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send invitations to 10 friends"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_GameListReceived" name="Game list received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_GameList" messageRef="Msg_GameList"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parallel_Split" name="Start date search and game check"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_Date" name="Date search merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointDate" name="Appoint date"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DateCheck" name="At least 8 agree?"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Date_Join" name="Date and games ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckGames" name="Check which games are owned"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Games_Split" name="Games missing?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DownloadGames" name="Download missing games"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_Games" name="Games check merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EstimateBeer" name="Estimate required beer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Beer_Split" name="Enough beer?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyBeer" name="Buy missing beer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_Beer" name="Beer check merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnjoyLANParty" name="Enjoy LAN party"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LANParty" name="LAN party finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_Planning" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Event_GameListReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Event_GameListReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Merge_Date"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Merge_Date" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Gateway_DateCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" name="8 or more agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateCheck" targetRef="Gateway_Date_Join">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">at least 8 friends agree on the date</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" name="Fewer than 8 agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateCheck" targetRef="Merge_Date">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">fewer than 8 friends agree on the date</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_CheckGames" targetRef="Gateway_Games_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="Some missing" sourceRef="Gateway_Games_Split" targetRef="Task_DownloadGames">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">some requested games are missing</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="All owned" sourceRef="Gateway_Games_Split" targetRef="Merge_Games">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">all requested games are owned</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_DownloadGames" targetRef="Merge_Games"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Merge_Games" targetRef="Gateway_Date_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Date_Join" targetRef="Task_EstimateBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_EstimateBeer" targetRef="Gateway_Beer_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" name="Not enough" sourceRef="Gateway_Beer_Split" targetRef="Task_BuyBeer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">not enough beer is available</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" name="Enough" sourceRef="Gateway_Beer_Split" targetRef="Merge_Beer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">enough beer is available</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_BuyBeer" targetRef="Merge_Beer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Merge_Beer" targetRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty" targetRef="End_LANParty"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
